messages.subject: poppr version 2.8.5 is on CRAN
parts:
Poppr version 2.8.5 has just been released to CRAN and will be built for windows and MacOS soon.

This is yet another maintenance release but does have some user-facing changes. If you use the poppr() function, then the columns "Pop" and "File" will now be characters by default instead of factors. If you had relied on this fact, one solution is to add two lines of code below the poppr call that converts these two columns back to factors. See more here: https://github.com/grunwaldlab/poppr/releases/tag/v.2.8.5

All the best,
Zhian
